conclusion: PASS: LLG physics reproduces the calibrated behavioral sigmoid within MC noise (threshold match 0.2 mV = 0.01 V_T, RMSE=0.066, 200 trials). => directive-2 dual-model policy validated: iterate on the cheap behavioral model, the compute-heavy LLG solver confirms the device sigmoid. R_SOT=776 ohm maps I_SOT->V; AP->P 0.75 ns thermal protocol (self-heating ON = calibration point); MC noise ~1/sqrt(200). Caveat: above ~0.92 V the LLG P_sw plateaus BELOW the behavioral sigmoid (over-drive precessional back-switching, a real LLG feature the monotonic behavioral sigmoid omits) -- the behavioral model is validated in the OPERATING REGION near threshold, not in deep over-drive.
